components.description: D3-computed rings show margin versus idle funds and notional position composition. Production sectors and legend rows share pointer/keyboard inspection and click, Enter, or Space selection. This static 30/70 sample is illustrative.
components.css: .ds-ring{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:180px;aspect-ratio:1;margin-inline:auto;font-family:'Manrope','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--hi,#f5f7f7)}.ds-ring svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}.ds-ring path{transition:opacity 160ms ease,filter 160ms ease}.ds-ring path:hover,.ds-ring path:focus{filter:brightness(1.12)}.ds-ring svg:has(path:hover) path:not(:hover),.ds-ring svg:has(path:focus) path:not(:focus){opacity:.35}.ds-ring path:focus-visible{outline:none;stroke:var(--hi,#f5f7f7);stroke-width:2}.ds-ring-center{position:absolute;inset:26% 18%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;pointer-events:none;text-align:center}.ds-ring-center span{font-size:10px;color:var(--mid,#b0b9bc);max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-ring-center strong{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',ui-monospace,'SFMono-Regular',monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:17px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.2;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-ring-center small{font-size:9px;color:var(--lo,#828d92)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-ring path{transition-duration:.01ms}}

narrative.northStar: 石墨投研台 / Graphite Research Workstation
narrative.overview:
The graphite research workstation (石墨投研台) is XG fund's restrained, continuous workspace for inspecting balances, exposure, and performance. Neutral graphite surfaces, pale mineral green, aligned numerals, and compact divisions make repeated comparison the dominant visual activity.

The interface stays flat and information-led. Manrope carries navigation and labels; IBM Plex Mono separates financial readings from prose. Color identifies fund performance, benchmarks, losses, and control state. Lucide icons and data-derived charts supply the visual assets; there is no shipping raster imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Flat graphite surfaces with fine dividers.
Compact headings and aligned financial numerals.
Mineral green actions, distinct benchmark colors, and soft red losses.
Desktop comparison layouts that collapse into direct mobile reading order.

rules.name: The Data Color Rule
rules.body: Use the established fund, benchmark, and gain/loss colors consistently; pair color with labels, signs, or direction text.

rules.name: The Aligned Number Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Mono and tabular numerals for financial values; preserve precision, units, and financial meaning.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Separate page sections with spacing and fine rules. Reserve a bordered container for an individual item or a genuinely framed control.

dos: Do preserve the XG fund identity and graphite, mineral-green visual world.
Do give amounts, percentages, units, timestamps, and data freshness stable, legible positions.
Do use the same semantic colors and aligned number treatment across charts, tables, and summaries.
Do preserve visible focus, labelled icon controls, loading states, and touch-friendly interactions.
Do let sections reflow and let wide tables scroll within their own region.
donts: Don't turn routed page sections into stacks of floating cards.
Don't add decorative gradients, illustrations, or motion to the financial workspace.
Don't encode a financial distinction through color alone.
Don't enlarge compact-panel headings into hero typography or scale type continuously with viewport width.
Don't hide chart readings beneath pointer-following overlays or let changing values shift adjacent controls.
